title: spectral occlusion - attribution beyond spatial relevance heatmaps
core_idea: Introduce spectral occlusion (s-occ), a method that uses spectral (Fourier-domain) manipulation to attribute model decisions to distributed and overlapping image features such as colors and textures, providing multiple visualizations that complement conventional spatial relevance heatmaps for more holistic explanations in complex vision tasks.
tldr: Spectral occlusion applies Fourier-based spectral manipulations to produce attribution perspectives that highlight dispersed, non-spatial features (e.g., color and texture), complementing spatial heatmaps to improve explainability in high-stakes vision domains like medical imaging.
